links.name: Lu4
Backstab Lv. 1 Supplements P. Atk. with 1107 Power to strike an enemy's unprotected back. Available when equipped with a dagger or a dual dagger. Over-hit, critical hit and half-kill are possible.
Bandage Lv. 1 Cures minor bleeding.
Whirlwind Lv. 1 Swings a spear to attack nearby enemies with 554 Power added to P. Atk. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Sweeper Lv. 1 Used on the corpses of Spoiled monsters to obtain extra items. Absorbs 30 HP and 10 MP from a corpse depending on the character's level.
Spoil Lv. 1 Imbues a monster with magic that renders it susceptible to the Sweeper skill.
Deadly Blow Lv. 1 Attacks the target's vital points with 1107 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit. Half-kill.
Spoil Festival Lv. 1 Imbues a monsters with magic that makes them susceptible to the Sweeper skill.
Sweeper Festival Lv. 1 When used on nearby corpses that are in a Spoil state, extra items may be obtained.

Crushing Strike Lv. 1 Impacts the enemy with 1041 Power added to P. Atk, decreasing the target's P. Def. by 10% and M. Def. by 10%. Decreases the target's Stun resistance by 10%. Over-hit is possible. Cancels Resist Shock effect from the target with 35% rate. Cancels Improved Resist effect from the target with 25% rate.
Lucky Blow Lv. 1 Imbues a monster with magic that renders it susceptible to the Sweeper skill. Inflicts physical damage. Power: 4348. Half-kill, Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Thrill Fight Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. +5% Speed -20%.
Braveheart Lv. 1 Restores 1000 CP instantly. Restores 66 CP every second.
Final Secret Lv. 1 Attack Damage in PvP +15% P. Skills Power in PvP and PvE +30%.
Hide Lv. 1 Hides the user. Effect is canceled if any action other than movement is initiated. Damage of any first attack +15% Speed -30%.

Coin Flipping Lv. 1 You flip a coin and receive a random effect: an attack boost or a defense boost. Heads: P. Atk. +5% M. Atk. +10% Atk. Spd. +5% Cast. Spd. +5%. Tails: P. Def. +5% M. Def. +6% Resistance to de-buffs +10% Incoming Heal Power +10%. Duration: 300 sec. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Effect only works while in a party with the caster.

Hammer Crush Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 487 Power to stun an enemy. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. While the effect is active, Resistance to Stun is significantly increased.
Dwarven Craft Lv. 1 Can read Dwarven recipe books.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Fake Death Lv. 1 Plays dead to keep a monster from attacking. Consumes 10 MP per second.
Parry Stance Lv. 1 P. Def. +15% M. Def. +15% Speed -5% Atk. Spd. -10% Accuracy -3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.

Riposte Stance Lv. 1 Returns 20% of received standard short-range damage back to an enemy Reflects debuffs with 20% probability Speed -5% Atk. Spd. -10% Accuracy -3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Polearm Accuracy Lv. 1 Accuracy +2 when using a spear. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
War Frenzy Lv. 1 Resistance to Stun +5% Resistance to Sleep +10%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Blazing Boost Lv. 1 Charges toward an enemy. Can't be used with a Bow. Minimal range: 200.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Create Item Lv. 1 Allows the user to manufacture level 1 items. Dwarven Manufacture size: +1 slot.

Sword/Blunt Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using one-handed/two-handed Sword or one-handed/two-handed/dual Blunt weapon, with an additional increase of 2.7 when using Sword, or 3 when using all Blunt types weapon.
Dagger Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 3.6 when use dagger/dual dagger.
Polearm Mastery Lv. 1 With Polearm: P. Atk. +5 Additional targets +3.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +4 Evasion +3.
Heavy Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +2 Incoming Heal Power +5%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Crystallize Lv. 1 Makes D-Grade crystallization possible.

Collector's Experience Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 72.7 when using a sword/blunt weapon. Increases Shield Defence by 10% when using a shield. There's a chance that Collector's Fortune will be activated on yourself when using Crushing Strike or Lucky Strike.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Potential Ability Lv. 1 With Light Armor and Dagger/Dual Dagger: P. Crit. Rate +15% P. Crit. Damage +177.
Vital Force Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 when sitting.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Boost HP Lv. 1 Increases Max HP by 60.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Coup De Grace Lv. 1 With Dagger/Dual Dagger: P. Crit. Damage +15% Speed +6. Ordinary attacks have a 10% chance to apply: Skills Hit Time -7%. Duration: 20 sec.
Weight Limit Lv. 1 Increases Weight Limit by 100%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Expose Weak Point Lv. 1 When attacked, 5% chance apply to enemy: P. Def. -20% Received P. Crit. Rate +30%. Duration: 15 sec. Reuse time: 30 sec.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Knock Lv. 1 When using 'Rush', 'Assault', 'Charge', 'Blazing Boost', applies to enemy: Speed -50%.
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Master of Combat Lv. 1 Max CP +3% P. Atk. with Sword/Dual Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt, Polearm, Dual Fist +25.
